stage: Stage 6.2C — TC-02 Input Mechanism & Runner Safety Report
tc02_target_query: How do I practice Completion with Integrity when closing projects?

1_verified_behavior_of_n8n_execute.trigger_output: The manualTrigger node in CLI mode outputs a single empty item: [{ 'json': {} }].
1_verified_behavior_of_n8n_execute.normalizer_behavior: The downstream 'Query Input & Normalizer' node checks firstItem.json.query and firstItem.json.text. When both are missing, it defaults to 'Hello'.
1_verified_behavior_of_n8n_execute.tc01_relevance: This default behavior allowed TC-01 ('Hello') to execute seamlessly, but it prevents non-greeting queries from running via bare CLI execution.

2_cli_input_data_support.pin_data_resolution: Inspected /usr/local/lib/node_modules/n8n/dist/workflow-runner.js: resolvePinData(data) explicitly checks if executionMode is 'manual' or 'evaluation'. In 'cli' mode, pinData is returned as undefined.
2_cli_input_data_support.conclusion: The native 'n8n execute' CLI binary does not support passing dynamic item payloads or query strings directly via command-line arguments.

options_analyzed.mechanism: Send an HTTP POST to http://127.0.0.1:5678/rest/workflows/TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U/run with destinationNode and test data in 'manual' executionMode.
options_analyzed.pros: Supported natively by n8n server; runs inside existing daemon without port 5679 task-broker collision; respects inactive workflow state (active: false); delivers exact { query: '...' } payload to 'Query Input & Normalizer'.
options_analyzed.cons: Requires n8n UI/REST authentication session or internal request.

options_analyzed.method: Option 2: Test Runner with Dynamic Input Parameter / Execution Script
options_analyzed.mechanism: Execute via n8n's internal runner script in node inside genx-n8n container that instantiates WorkflowRunner with executionMode: 'manual' and pinData: { 'When clicking ‘Execute workflow’': [{ json: { query: '...' } }] }.
options_analyzed.pros: Direct container execution; 100% reproducible; passes exact query; workflow remains inactive; zero modifications to TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U; captures complete DAG runData and node outputs.
options_analyzed.cons: Requires a standalone Python/Node bridge inside container.

options_analyzed.method: Option 3: Fallback Parameter in Query Input & Normalizer
options_analyzed.mechanism: Update 'Query Input & Normalizer' to check $env.RETRIEVAL_QUERY or fallback query.
options_analyzed.pros: Allows running via 'docker exec -e RETRIEVAL_QUERY=... n8n execute'.
options_analyzed.cons: Violates the strict rule: 'Do not modify workflow JSON, SQL, database records, credentials, or ingestion workflow.'

3_supported_methods_to_pass_query.recommended_approach: Option 2 (Direct n8n WorkflowRunner bridge inside container in 'manual' mode with pinData) or Option 1, preserving TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U 100% untouched while delivering the exact coaching query.

4_can_current_runner_safely_execute.reason: If executed with bare 'n8n execute --id=TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U', the workflow would receive an empty item from manualTrigger and fall back to 'Hello' (re-running TC-01 instead of TC-02). A dedicated input-injection runner must be approved first.

5_limitations_and_unresolved_uncertainti: Native 'n8n execute' has no --data or --input argument for manual triggers.
Workflow TSvKBGpM9nK7eb3U must remain completely unmodified, requiring input injection to occur at the execution boundary.
Workflow must remain inactive (active: false) at all times.
